description: Thresholds of the triage checks C1-C9 and the exit-mix guard: draft values from the requirements, checked for consistency on synthetic cases, not calibrated. Only this file is used; change values only here, with date and reason.

requires.tradeblocksPending: first TradeBlocks release containing tradeblocks-org/tradeblocks#640, #641 and #642 (#640 includes the former #639 and #648; #648 is the paired-comparison grid fix: day grid from the compared strategies only); the minimum version, for information (the tool checks below detect an older server)
requires.description: A missing tool or option makes its check not run. The interval fix (the former #639, now in #640) cannot be detected from the tool list; until a release with it is pinned, the interval guard (point outside its own interval -> cap) is the only protection.

C1.name: Backtest matches its source

ask.structure: which legs are sold and bought (e.g. put credit spread and call credit spread).
ask.legs: one value each for the short-leg rule (delta, points offset or target credit) and the spread width.
ask.dte: the days to expiration at entry (one number).
ask.entry_time: every entry time (HH:mm ET), or the first time, the spacing and the count.
ask.days_traded: the weekdays traded (or every trading day).
ask.stop: the stop type and value (e.g. loss of 1x the credit), or that there is no stop.
ask.exit: the profit target or exit time, or that trades are held to stop or expiry.
ask.date_range: the first and last month (or day) of the author's record.

C1.reason: no guessing: any core field not stated (assumed, n/a or missing) caps; ask = what the NOT_BUILDABLE message asks per core field

C2.name: Sample can carry a verdict
C2.reason: draft values from the requirements, checked on synthetic A1-A5, not tuned; entries are distinct open date and time (one exit group per side counts once); distinctContractCounts enforces fixed size

C3.name: Backtest trades the stated expiries
C3.reason: draft value from the requirements, checked on synthetic A1-A5, not tuned

C4.name: Edge is more than harvested premium (gate)
C4.reason: draft value from the requirements, checked on synthetic A1-A5, not tuned

C5.name: Result does not hang on a few days
C5.reason: draft value from the requirements, checked on synthetic A1-A5, not tuned

C6.name: Strategy survives stress
C6.reason: draft values from the requirements; only windows fully inside the record's range count; a non-positive average month gives 99 (reject)

C7.name: Edge survives realistic costs
C7.reason: draft value from the requirements, checked on synthetic A1-A5, not tuned

C8.name: Result does not hang on the start date
C8.reason: V1.1 draft values from the requirements, checked on synthetic A1-A9, not tuned; a record under 30 months is not tested here, without a cap (C2 accepts 24 months)

C9.name: Edge does not hang on the exact stop
C9.reason: V1.1 draft values from the requirements, checked on synthetic A1-A9, not tuned

exitMix.name: realistic run trades like the author run
exitMix.reason: draft value, decided after review v2; checked on the real e2e case, not tuned; above it C4-C9 are not run (fixed consequence, no outcome field)
